name: Buddha
hook: One prince, one bodhi tree, one middle path: the Buddha clues keep returning.

facts.label: Siddhartha Gautama
facts.statement: The Buddha was born Siddhartha Gautama, a prince of the Sakya kingdom on the border of present-day Nepal and India.

facts.label: the Bodhi tree
facts.statement: He reached enlightenment while meditating under a bodhi tree; December's Bodhi Day marks it.

facts.label: the Deer Park sermon
facts.statement: His first sermon, at the Deer Park, set out the Four Noble Truths, beginning with the truth that existence is suffering.

facts.label: nirvana
facts.statement: Nirvana is the final state and goal of the Buddhist path; a February holiday commemorates the Buddha reaching it.

facts.label: Siddhartha
facts.statement: Hermann Hesse's 1922 novel Siddhartha follows an Indian boy's spiritual journey in the Buddha's time.

facts.label: the Emerald Buddha
facts.statement: The Emerald Buddha sits in the Grand Palace in Bangkok, Thailand, on a gilded wood throne.

facts.label: the Great Buddha of Kamakura
facts.statement: Japan's Great Buddha at Kamakura was cast in 1252 in bronze, and the 93-ton statue is the country's most famous bronze.
